summary: NatWest Group plc furnished a Form 6-K containing a London Stock Exchange announcement dated 29 September 2026 regarding board committee chair succession. Roisin Donnelly will succeed Lena Wilson as Chair of the Group Performance and Remuneration Committee effective 1 October 2026. Chair Rick Haythornthwaite thanked Wilson and welcomed Donnelly, citing her board and remuneration experience. No Listing Rule 6.4.6R disclosures were required. This is a routine governance announcement, not a forced or abrupt CEO/CFO/board departure, so it falls outside special-situations categories; no deal terms, advisors, or risk-arb angle apply.
